FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Cycle Haven Bikes is a retail operation focused exclusively on the sale and service of bicycles and related accessories. We maintain a dedicated physical storefront at 123 Bicycle Lane, Suite A, Springfield, IL, where our customers can browse a wide range of bicycles, from casual cruisers to high-performance road bikes. Our knowledgeable staff, all trained in bicycle mechanics, provide expert advice and personalized service to ensure customers find the perfect fit for their needs.

In addition to retail, we offer bicycle repair services within our shop, ensuring all repairs are conducted by qualified technicians. We do not engage in bicycle rental or loaner programs, which helps us manage risk and maintain high service quality. Cycle Haven Bikes adheres to all local and state regulations, ensuring compliance with licensing, safety standards, and liability insurance requirements. We prioritize customer safety and product quality through rigorous inventory management and secure storage practices, including established security measures at our location. Regular training and quality checks help us maintain exceptional service standards and a solid reputation in the community.
